headlines.text: US stock futures edge higher Monday as Wall Street enters a pivotal week headlined by Wednesday's Fed rate decision and a wave of Big Tech earnings, following last week's second straight S&P 500 and Nasdaq weekly loss
Fed, ECB and Bank of Japan all deliver rate decisions this week, with Wednesday's FOMC meeting expected to hold at 3.75%-4.00% despite a hawkish tilt in September's minutes
Big Tech earnings crunch hits this week as Alphabet, Microsoft and Amazon report, with investors fixated on runaway AI capital spending and AWS cloud strength
Oil tumbles and stock futures extend gains after Trump rules out striking Iran, easing the war-risk premium that had pushed Brent above $115 a barrel on Houthi attacks
10-year Treasury yield holds just under 5% after its sharpest one-day drop in over two years as investors fled AI-linked tech stocks last week
